title: 節分のぬりえ
subject_en: Setsubun coloring pages in clean black outline only on a white background, no fill colour and no shading, thick even line, big closed shapes that are easy to colour in, each page one separate subject Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 鬼・豆まき・恵方巻・柊鰯・升など、節分の行事を黒い線だけで描いた12点のぬりえ素材です。保育園・学童の製作や、季節のおたよりの飾りに使えます。
